<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:8">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:4">Ex. R. s. 6</cite>, a. e. <he>ח׳ על דאבדין וכ׳</he> Oh, for those who are gone and cannot be replaced! <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26:2">Ex. R. s. 26</cite>; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 6 (prov.) <he>נפל ביתא ח׳ לכוותא</he> (not <cite ref="A00153"><he>אבל</he></cite>) when the house falls, woe to the windows!; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesachim 20b:24">Pes. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>תשפך ח׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) it must be poured out (and go) to ruin; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 116a">B.
